description: `paper`: section-aware (Abstract, Introduction, Method, ..., References)
`book`: chapter/section hierarchy from headings or TOC depth
`laws`: Chapter / Section / Article / Item hierarchy
`presentation`: one chunk group per slide with slide title appended
`table`: one chunk per row prefixed with table title and column headers
`qa`: question/answer pairs from Excel/CSV/text; question stored in `question_tks`
`resume`: structured CV entities (name, contact, work history, education, skills)
`picture`: VLM description of images indexed as chunks
`manual`: groups code blocks, parameter tables, subsection diagrams
`email`: From/To/Subject/Date/Body sections
`tag`: extracts tag features and tag weights
`one`: whole document as a single chunk
`audio`: ASR transcript segmented into timestamped chunks

Text preprocessing: full-to-half-width, traditional-to-simplified Chinese, URL/email stripping, tokenize, fine-grained tokenize, token positions — *partly delivered in Phase 4 (R-160, D-27): full-to-half-width, URL/email stripping, tokenize and token positions through the in-repo stdlib tokenizer; traditional-to-simplified conversion and the dictionary fine-grained tokenizer move to Phase 6*
LLM keyword extraction per chunk populates `important_kwd`
LLM question proposal per chunk populates `question_tks`
LLM content tagging against tag sets
LLM auto-metadata generation (`gen_metadata`)
RAPTOR hierarchical summarization (cluster, summarize, index summary chunks) when enabled on the dataset
Public built-in pipeline listing: `GET /api/v1/pipelines?type=builtin`, `GET /api/v1/pipelines/:id`
Go chunker mirrors for `naive`, `one`, `qa`, `table`, `presentation` *(Python implementation in v1; Go mirror deferred to v2)*
`deepdoc` profile running the layout-parsing service on 9390
User can batch-update document metadata via `PATCH /datasets/<dataset_id>/documents/metadatas`
User can fetch an extracted image via `GET /documents/images/<image_id>`
User can fetch a generated artifact via `GET /documents/artifact/<filename>`
Dataset-wide fan-out tasks using sentinel document ids
User can aggregate tags across datasets via `GET /datasets/tags/aggregation`
User can list and delete tags of a dataset via `GET` / `DELETE /datasets/<dataset_id>/tags`
User can fetch flattened metadata across datasets via `GET /datasets/metadata/flattened`
User can read a dataset's auto-metadata configuration via `GET /datasets/<dataset_id>/metadata/config`
User can delete a derived index of a dataset by type via `DELETE /datasets/<dataset_id>/<index_type>` and trace it via `GET /datasets/<dataset_id>/artifacts/alteration`
Vision (image-to-text) model type
Speech-to-text (ASR) model type
OCR model type
Prompt generators: keyword extraction, question proposal, content tagging, metadata generation, chunk formatting
Layout analysis (DLA) detects regions labelled Text, Title, Figure, Figure caption, Table, Table caption, Header, Footer, Reference, Equation
Text boxes are assigned to layout regions at overlap ratio >= 0.4; duplicates removed by IoU NMS; regions sorted into reading order
OCR fallback (text detection plus recognition) runs when a page's text layer is missing or corrupt
Table structure recognition reconstructs cropped tables into HTML `<table>`
Headers and footers are filtered from chunk content

DOCX parser: paragraphs, headings, embedded images, tables as HTML *(Python implementation in v1; Go mirror deferred to v2)* — *partly delivered in Phase 4 (R-160, D-27): paragraphs, headings and tables as HTML; embedded images are skipped and counted in the log; image handling moves to Phase 6*

PPTX parser: slide titles, text frames, shape tables, speaker notes, images — *partly delivered in Phase 4 (R-160, D-27): slide titles, text frames, shape tables and speaker notes; images are skipped and counted in the log; image handling moves to Phase 6*
Markdown parser
JSON parser
EPUB parser
CSV ingestion
Image files (JPG, PNG) are parsed via OCR and/or VLM description
Embedded figures are extracted, hashed for dedup (`image2id`), captioned by a vision model, and stored
Audio files (MP3, WAV) are transcribed by an ASR model
Email (`.eml`) parsed into From, To, Subject, Date, Body
Pluggable external PDF parsers: Docling and MinerU wrappers
Additional parser backends: PaddleOCR, Mistral, TCADP, SoMark, OpenDataLoader, figure parser
DLA / OCR / TSR can be offloaded to a remote DeepDoc service (`DEEPDOC_URL`, `TENSORRT_DLA_SVR`; container port 9390)
Parsing honours the `pages` range in `parser_config`
Go PDF and DOCX parser implementations with CGO bindings (PDFium, OfficeOxide) *(Python implementation in v1; Go mirror deferred to v2)*
Native document parsing isolated in the `deepdoc` container
Extracted images and table crops are stored under `{tenant_id}/{doc_id}/{img_id}.png` and `.../tables/{table_id}.png`

Parser configurator: chunk token size, delimiter, layout-model toggle, auto-keyword count — *partly delivered in Phase 4 (R-160, D-27): chunk token size and delimiter; the layout-model toggle and the auto-keyword count move to Phase 6*
